entities.name: Baki
entities.description: A dwarven wizard attendant of unknown gender on the Council of Wizards on the Floating Isle, Ulgrotha, around the time of the Homelands.

entities.name: Council of Wizards
entities.description: The ruling body of the Wizards' School on the Floating Isle, which maintains neutrality and safe seas for trade.
